name: LPT Master

cost.note: earned through CPENT exam (same exam + range bundle $999); awarded automatically to candidates scoring 90%+ on the CPENT 24-hour practical exam; no separate purchase

levelNote: Not a separate exam. EC-Council awards LPT (Master) automatically to anyone scoring 90% or above on the same CPENT sitting, so the gap over CPENT reflects a higher cut line on one exam — real, but worth a few points, not a rank above CREST's certification exams and Zero-Point's CRTL. EC-Council publishes no difficulty rating for its courses, so the weight here is read off what the programme actually is rather than assumed from the vendor. Exam-only score 68, +5 for the training.

name: CPENT

cost.note: exam + 90-day practice range bundle from EC-Council Store; training bundles start at $1,999

prerequisites: Two years information security experience, or CEH
levelNote: A genuine 24-hour practical across five ranges with a report due within seven days, at a 70% cut. Re-based off a 24-hour exam rather than the breadth of the syllabus: it is comparable to OSCP in what it asks of a candidate on the day, and cannot outrank credentials examined over 160 hours or more. EC-Council publishes no difficulty rating for its courses, so the weight here is read off what the programme actually is rather than assumed from the vendor. 40 hours of instruction and 110+ labs supports intermediate weight. Exam-only score 62, +7 for the training.

name: CEH Master

cost.note: no separate purchase; earned automatically when holder passes both CEH knowledge (312-50v13) and CEH Practical exams

levelNote: Composite credential, awarded for holding CEH and CEH Practical. No training weight applied — that would count the same courseware twice. Tracks its components. Exam-only score 56; no training weight.

name: CEH Practical

cost.note: standalone practical exam voucher; also available bundled with knowledge exam voucher

levelNote: Six hours, 20 challenges, no report. Above the short practicals, below anything demanding a written deliverable. 20 challenges in 6 hours on the Aspen range at a 70% cut, with no report. Re-based hard: at 62 it sat level with CRTO (96 hours) and above PNPT (five days plus a report), which a six-hour challenge exam cannot support. EC-Council publishes no difficulty rating for its courses, so the weight here is read off what the programme actually is rather than assumed from the vendor. The 221 labs behind CEH are substantial and carry intermediate weight.

cost.note: Retired by EC-Council in 2021; replaced by CPENT.

name: COASP

cost.note: training bundles start at $1,699 on-demand; standalone exam voucher price not verified from primary source

levelNote: Re-based onto the common knowledge-exam scale. A hybrid assessment on a young syllabus. AI security is roughly three years old as a discipline and its credentials have not yet accumulated the depth of the established expert-tier certs. The whole column was re-rated together on that basis. EC-Council courseware with a hybrid exam; scope is broad rather than deep.

name: CEH

cost.note: exam voucher via Pearson VUE; RPS (remote-proctored) voucher also available, pricing differs; training bundles start at $1,699

levelNote: Re-based onto the common knowledge-exam scale. 125 questions in 4 hours on a broad professional syllabus, with no published fixed cut score. 125 multiple-choice questions in 4 hours. EC-Council does not publish a fixed cut score for it — their own guidance puts the range at 60–85% depending on exam form — so the assessment guarantee is weaker than a body that publishes one per exam. Re-based below PenTest+, which carries performance-based questions. EC-Council publishes no difficulty rating for its courses, so the weight here is read off what the programme actually is rather than assumed from the vendor. 20 modules and 221 labs is real content and carries intermediate weight, capped at +5 because the exam is pure multiple choice.
